title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Intraday Agent manages queues and schedule adherence
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and workforce-alerts setting are supported, and targeted searches found no documentation resolving the agent's licensing, default or controls. One descriptive sentence includes schedulers as alert recipients, although the roadmap names only supervisors.
